scripts.pods: cd ios && bundle install && bundle exec pod install
scripts.pods:update: cd ios && bundle exec pod install --repo-update
scripts.pods:clean: rm -rf ios/Pods ios/Podfile.lock ios/build && npm run pods
scripts.build:ios:debug: xcodebuild -workspace ios/Rad.xcworkspace -scheme Rad -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build build
scripts.build:ios:release: xcodebuild -workspace ios/Rad.xcworkspace -scheme Rad -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ios/build/Rad.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
scripts.build:ios:ipa: npm run build:ios:release && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/build/Rad.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ios/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath ios/build/ipa -allowProvisioningUpdates
scripts.clean: npm run clean:android && npm run clean:ios
